digest.component_or_area: developer guidance and workflow tooling for source-code navigation
propositions: Agents default to grep over Serena's symbol tools despite explicit guidance because bash is already in-hand for other tasks while Serena requires an extra ToolSearch discovery round-trip, creating friction asymmetry that favors the cheaper tool
Static documentation guidance decays through a long session; by turn six, the original guidance has no salience against working memory, causing agents to forget or ignore the preference

Serena cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib.import_module), so a rule to prefer Serena exclusively would miss actual call sites and teaches agents to discount the rule
Serena's LSP index can lag recent edits by multiple lines within a session, while grep reports current-tree positions accurately, making both tools necessary for complete reference enumeration

The division of labor between grep (string-literal refs, fresh edits) and Serena (structural call sites) must be documented in AGENTS.md; a PreToolUse hook on Bash should remind agents of Serena on each grep invocation; symbol tools should be non-deferred to remove friction; and a project-level rebar criterion plus coaching move should catch incomplete hand-enumeration in reviews
